OPEC At A Crossroads
Will OPEC's influence fade or will the cartel adapt again? The crisis in the Middle East and, in particular, the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most important maritime chokepoints, has reminded oil markets of the importance of Middle East OPEC.
